title: Nested-INSERT consumer scaling and peer-test denominator audit
mode: Primary-source issue, repository, and local source review; research-only plan refinement
worktreeState: Dirty shared worktree; preserved existing changes
scope: Screen a current open-source DWG/DXF consumer report for nested block expansion and resource behavior.
Compare the reported application stage with libdxfrw's structural block/INSERT conversion boundary.
Check peer test-data disclosures so default test success is not mistaken for real-file/native qualification.
Add a bounded optional consumer checkpoint without expanding the per-slice test loop or adding a parser feature.

sources.revision: Issue and mutable main/Cargo.toml checked 2026-10-19; issue-linked changes are maintainer-reported on mutable main
sources.observed: Open issue #1698 reports that a private AC1032 customer drawing parsed in about 1.9 seconds but eager model-space INSERT expansion produced 6,128,569 primitives and reached about 8.94 GiB. The maintainer reports shared prototype/stub instances and duplicate-memo removal, with a synthetic 2.4M-line case improving from 5.4 GB/2.4 seconds to 0.37 GB/36 milliseconds. Differing rotation/scale still expands separately. The mutable manifest declares version 2026.42.0 and pins opencadcodec revision 5d4f11a and opencadkernel revision a60f18f; its binding to the v2026.42 release artifact was not verified.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Application-side report and maintainer-reported synthetic benchmark only. The customer file was unavailable, the issue remains open, and release inclusion/artifact binding and independent reproduction were not established. Does not establish a libdxfrw defect, file-format rule, consumer scalability guarantee, or parser-independent semantic result.

sources.observed: The project says tests requiring drawings absent from the repository are marked ignored and that CI runs default/all-feature tests across supported platforms.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A default green test command can omit external-file cases; no ACadRust build or test command was run. ACadRust and its application descendants remain one codec lineage.

sources.observed: The ledger states its 36 file tests are synthetic and that output has not been checked in AutoCAD; it also lists current ACadRust-lineage DWG preservation gaps.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project-authored readiness disclosure, not an independent parser or native acceptance result.

sources.observed: The adapter retains block definitions, owner identities, INSERT placement and attribute sequences as document graph records; generated tests include nested and attributed block references. The consumer contract assigns nested placement composition to downstream consumers and records MINSERT spacing as source data.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Bounded local structural evidence only; no renderer/consumer expansion or memory qualification.

assessment.planImpact: Separates libdxfrw's retained block/INSERT graph from downstream primitive expansion, adds an optional source-bound consumer-scale checkpoint, and requires peer comparisons to disclose ignored/external test inputs. No parser limit, runtime dependency, required peer run, new defect, or support promotion follows.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep per-slice validation limited to the touched strict target, focused generated selector, owning CTest, and scoped diff check.

For a touched block/INSERT path, use a bounded locally generated graph and assert definition/INSERT cardinality, source identity, owner closure, placement, attributes, and following-record integrity before any downstream expansion.

At the existing composed checkpoint only, use a pinned consumer if already available; record artifact/codec/kernel identity, source/output hashes, read diagnostics, graph counts, transform classes, expanded primitive count, memory/time, and omissions separately.
Do not use private/customer samples or peer memory measurements as a local threshold; do not add a parser expansion cap for work the library does not perform.
For peer suites, record exact command and ignored-test list/count. Green synthetic/self-round-trip tests do not establish real-file/native or independent geometry semantics.
If the consumer or exact artifact is unavailable/unbound, report NOT_RUN and continue local work; do not wait on external availability.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review and local source/plan crosswalk
method.limitations: OpenCADStudio's OOM case is an unavailable customer drawing and its reported optimization/performance result is maintainer-authored for a synthetic case. The release manifest binds source dependency revisions but this pass did not run the app or independently test release contents. Peer test-data statements were read from mutable documentation. Results refine the qualification plan only.
